verdict: Cost per lead spiked 37% this week; immediate steps are underway.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 177 leads at an average cost of $10.49 per lead, but the most recent 7-day window shows a sharp step down — leads fell 29% week-over-week while spend held nearly flat, pushing cost per lead up 37% against your own prior baseline. The decline in daily leads has been confirmed across the past several days, and a near-zero spend day on Google Ads on November 8th (likely a budget exhaustion issue, not a planned pause) contributed to lost volume. Ad creative and budget pacing are being reviewed and corrected this week. If those fixes hold, you should see cost per lead stabilize and daily lead volume recover toward prior levels in the next reporting period.
